messages.subject: For Larry Culp | Aerospace growth, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear GE Aerospace Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. H. Lawrence Culp Jr., Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

GE Aerospace's global growth across commercial and defense aviation requires disciplined alignment across governments, aviation authorities, supply-chain partners and strategic customers. That interface closely matches my experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, including coordination with aviation and other public authorities.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, aviation coordination and industrial stakeholder strategy might support GE Aerospace's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to GE Aerospace.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
